title: Baithe hai azadaar azakhaane me
body:
Ya Fatema Zahra..(7)
<<MINI>>
Ya Zahra, Ya Zahra, Ya Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Chand moharram ka roya aur hum
jab aaya moharram, aur aankh hui nam
ye madar e hasnain se, karte hai iltejaa
saare azadaar, saare azadaar
ya bint e nabi fatima tashreef le aao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghar apna azakhana e shabbir banaya
matam ke liye farsh e azaa ghar mein bichaya
Ya Fatema Zehra tumhe purse ko bulaya..(2)
saqqa e sakina ka alam ham ne sajaya
tum aake azakhane ki tauqeer badhao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jo aapne paye hai sare karbobala ghum
hum ehle azaa laye hai un zakhmo ka marham
ye sozo salam aaho buka marsiya matam..(2)
barsaenge aankho se abhi ashk e azaa hum
aye bibi inhe zeenat e rumaal banao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ek roz mein ujda hai jo zainab ka bhara ghar
us ghar ke azadaar hai sab farsh e azaa par
peetenge azadaar kabhi seena kabhi sar..(2)
thoda to sukoo payega faryaad ko sunkar
hamraah agar sayyed e sajjad ko lao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hum shakl e payambar ka hai besheer ka matam
laila ki buka banu e dilgeer ka matam
behno mein bapa chadar e tatheer ka matam..(2)
sajjad ke zakhmo ka hai zanjeer ka matam
abbas ko aur zainab e muztar ko bulao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Barpa hai yaha'n qasim o abbas ka matam
hai dukhtar e shabbir ke ehsaas ka matam
sukhe hue kuzo'n ka kabhi pyaas ka matam..(2)
jo toot gayi dasht mein us aas ka matam
sharbat pe alamdaar ki ab nazr dilao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aye bibi zara shor suno aaho buka ka
dil tukde hua jaata hai har ehle azaa ka
zakir ne kiya zikr jo bazaar e jafa ka..(2)
kya haal hai pucho to zara zainul ebaa ka
bazaar ka hai zikr to baqir ko bhi lao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Begoro kafan sayyed e zeeshan ka pursa
bazaar ka pursa hai ye zindaan ka pursa
sadaat ke bikhre hue samaan ka pursa..(2)
manzoor karo mazhar o irfan ka pursa
mil jaye sanad nauhe pe gar ashk bahao
<<MINI>>
baithe hai azadaar azakhane mein aao, azakhane mein aao
Ya binte nabi..
Ya Zahra, Ya Zahra, Ya Zahra
